metaTitel: Tarot & Coffee Cup Reading App for Android | Tarot Cup
metaBeschreibung: Tarot Cup is an Android app for coffee cup reading with 80 symbols and tarot readings with 78 cards, in twelve languages and offline.
ogTitel: Read your coffee cup. Draw tarot cards.

zeilen: Draw tarot cards *at your own pace*.
kopf.text: Choose the symbols from your cup, show on the cup map where they are, and read what they can mean. Or draw tarot cards at your own pace. The app works without internet and without an account.

karte.tipp: Tap the card and turn it over.
karte.satz: Its meaning, upright and reversed, can be found in the app’s Dictionary.

wasIst.text: Tarot Cup is an Android app for drawing tarot cards and reading the coffee grounds in your cup yourself. It is available in twelve languages; it starts in your phone’s language, and you can switch languages in the app. It is meant for people aged 16 and over and works without internet and without an account. The readings follow old traditions and are meant for entertainment.

schritte: Think of your question and finish your Turkish coffee. Turn the cup upside down onto the saucer and let it cool. You keep your question to yourself; the app does not ask for it.
Turn the cup slowly and look for the shapes among the 80 symbols.
Show on the cup map where each symbol is. With three or more symbols, you get the full reading.
